overall_summary: Husband-wife emotional relationship dynamics significantly outperform general family, motivation, or solo shayari topics. Sample size is small (14 videos), but the clear engagement outlier signals a strong demand for relatable post-marriage relationship reflections.

winning_patterns.evidence: Top 2 videos ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,766 views/61 likes and 'पत्नी की ये बात...' with 1,672 views/50 likes) generated 80%+ of total channel views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus core content strategy on post-marriage emotional friction, unsaid feelings, and everyday marital dynamics.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा...' got 13 views and 'तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं' got 172 views with low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic self-motivation and abstract poetry without a specific real-life scenario ground.

weak_patterns.evidence: Bhai/Behen videos averaged 19 to 136 views with negligible likes/comments.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize sibling content unless connected to a high-converting core narrative angle.
